summary: Page 2 of the Washington Bee. Target item 'As the Bee predicted' confirms Col. Wm. Murrell, editor of the New Jersey Trumpet, received his commission as an appointee (Interior Department, per adjacent 'They Say' column) and enters his new office May 25. A 'They Say' gossip item adds the Bee will take on the Trumpet's subscribers. Rest of page: editorial on political endorsements in DC, a Century Magazine excerpt on Black troops at Petersburg, notes on new public printer Frank W. Palmer and new DC commissioners, a Louisiana item on armed Black voter-protection patrols (400 Regulators in Arms), and job-printing/newspaper ads including for the Freeman (Indianapolis).

Murrell scheduled to enter upon duties of his new office
